reason: Both correctly identify the same three core defects (WHERE clause defeating the LEFT JOIN, missing UTC+8 conversion, integer division truncation) with equally accurate explanations, but Response B additionally surfaces a valid, non-obvious consequence—that once the join is fixed, NULL total_spent values will sort ahead of real totals in a DESC ORDER BY on most engines—which Response A never mentions even though it flags the related NULL/COALESCE issue for total_spent.
